name: Swami Vivekananda
bio: Spiritual leader who introduced Indian philosophy of Vedanta and Yoga to the Western world at the 1893 Chicago Parliament.

name: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose
bio: Legendary nationalist leader and commander-in-chief of the Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army).

name: Sarojini Naidu
bio: The 'Nightingale of India', prominent freedom fighter, poet, and first woman governor of an Indian state.

name: B. R. Ambedkar
bio: Chief architect of the Indian Constitution, social reformer, and first Law Minister of Independent India.

name: Sachin Tendulkar
bio: Widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in cricket history; the only player with 100 international centuries.

name: Rabindranath Tagore
bio: First non-European Nobel laureate (Literature, 1913) and composer of the national anthems of India and Bangladesh.

name: Karisma Kapoor
bio: Award-winning Bollywood actress and one of the highest-paid Indian female stars of the 1990s and early 2000s.

name: Sucheta Kripalani
bio: Freedom fighter and India's first woman Chief Minister (heading Uttar Pradesh government from 1963 to 1967).

name: MS Dhoni
bio: Legendary captain who led India to victories in the 2007 T20 World Cup, 2011 ODI World Cup, and 2013 Champions Trophy.

name: Sunil Gavaskar
bio: First batsman in cricket history to score 10,000 Test runs and 34 Test centuries.

name: Vikram Sarabhai
bio: Father of the Indian Space Program, founder of ISRO and the Physical Research Laboratory.

name: Major Dhyan Chand
bio: The 'Wizard of Hockey' who led India to three consecutive Olympic Gold medals (1928, 1932, 1936).

name: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
bio: Distinguished philosopher, India's second President, whose birthday is celebrated nationally as Teachers' Day.

name: Narendra Modi
bio: 14th Prime Minister of India, leading the nation through the Digital India, Make in India, and UPI transformation.

name: Bhagat Singh
bio: Charismatic revolutionary whose sacrifice inspired millions during India's freedom struggle.

name: Lata Mangeshkar
bio: The 'Queen of Melody' and Bharat Ratna recipient who recorded songs across thousands of Indian films.

name: Mahatma Gandhi
bio: Father of the Nation, pioneer of Satyagraha and non-violent civil disobedience.

name: Lal Bahadur Shastri
bio: Second Prime Minister of India, champion of the Green & White Revolutions, who gave the slogan 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan'.

name: Amitabh Bachchan
bio: The 'Shahenshah of Bollywood', defining Indian cinema across five decades from the 1970s to modern classics.

name: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
bio: The 'Missile Man of India', aerospace scientist, and 11th President of India loved as the 'People's President'.

name: Shah Rukh Khan
bio: The 'King of Bollywood' and global cultural icon starring in Indian cinema's biggest blockbusters.

name: Jawaharlal Nehru
bio: First Prime Minister of Independent India, whose birthday is celebrated as Children's Day.

name: Indira Gandhi
bio: India's first and only female Prime Minister to date, named 'Woman of the Millennium' in a 1999 BBC poll.

name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
bio: Mathematical genius who made extraordinary contributions to number theory, infinite series, and continued fractions.

name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
bio: Statesman, poet, and Prime Minister who oversaw Pokhran-II, the Golden Quadrilateral, and telecom reforms.
